lines.en: I walk with a strange gait.
I walk swinging my head, my steps all wrong.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I drag my feet around to your flank.
My shadow jitters on the ground.
I push out of the grass.
I come closer step by step.
I tilt as I walk.
My feet land solidly.
I go round the tree and on.
I turn at a strange angle.
I watch you while walking.

lines.zh: 我一个怪步一个怪步地凑
lines.en: I lurch over in odd little steps.
I slide down the slope.
I shift to the middle.
I stand with my head tipped.
I twist my body slowly.
My eyes stay stuck on you.
My two arms swing to and fro.
I hold myself up, tilted.
I roll my head side to side.
I am breathing slowly.
My eyes have not blinked.
My neck tilts, and my eyes roll around.
I go suddenly still.
I shake my shoulders, and my joints crack.
I wait for the next move.
I look left and right slowly.
I set my crooked feet straight.
I tip my face your way.
You look hittable.
I wriggle my way closer.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里那点东西
lines.en: I stare at what is in your hand.
I raise an arm slowly.
Are you not going to run?
I tilt my head and grin.

lines.zh: 我凑近，鼻息喷到你脸上。
lines.en: I lean in, breath puffing on your face.
I grin wide and wait for you to start.
You smell all right.

lines.zh: 我用长手指点了点你的鼻尖。
lines.en: I tap your nose with a long finger.
I edge your way.
I can see you breathe.
I am about to start.
You won't remember this face.
I give half a step.
I squeeze a grunt out of my throat.
A hum squeezes out of my throat.
I shake my dizzy head.

lines.zh: 我倒下去，又歪着站起来。
lines.en: I fall, then rise crooked again.
Blood is smeared on my clothes.
It hurts so much my neck ties itself in a knot.
I have not caught my breath.
I do not mean to stop here.
You hold that thing up.
I tilt my neck for a look.
I am not sure what this is.
I reach out and flick at it.
I do not eat that.
I bat it aside.
Then I look at you again.
This thing is boring.
I would rather hit you.
I turn away from it.
Your bump sends me back two steps.
I catch my feet and square up.
We meet with a dull thud.
I sway twice before settling.
You nearly knocked me over.
I shove you once.
My foot slides.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的头晃了两圈。
lines.en: One bump, and my head wobbles twice around.
I settle back into my stance.
You are heavier than you look.
Another sways over.
We tip our heads at the same angle.
It is thinner than I.
The two of us come at you as one.
We sway our heads together.
It takes its place beside me.
Neither of us says a word.
We turn our heads to you at once.
It steps forward first.
I follow it.
I fold over and grab it.
I hold it up and turn it.
I toss it behind me.
I open my mouth and bite.
Two chews and I spit it out.
I crush it flat.
I pick up another piece.
I pitch it away.
I bounce it in my palm.
I lose interest.
I rear my odd head up.
I straighten my neck.
One stride puts me at your feet.
My look has changed.
I stop swaying.
I close my fists.
I am about to start.
You are standing where I can hit you.
I bend low, as if to sprint.
This fist will not be gentle.

lines.zh: 我盯住你手里那块面包。
lines.en: My eyes fix on the bread in your hand.
I let my long arms hang to my knees.
You move, I move, stuck to you.
My eyes have not moved off you.
You go left; I follow left.
I wait for you to leave a gap.
I will not rush this swing.
Your hand lifts; I come on.

lines.zh: 重心压到最低，随时能扑。
lines.en: Weight down as low as it goes, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的功夫，我已绕后。
lines.en: While you lift a foot, I'm already behind you.
I come a little closer.
I have the distance.
Backing off will not help.
I can reach you any moment.
My fist lands on your shoulder.
I sweep my arm across.
I ram you off your feet.
You are knocked sideways.
I tack on one more.
I grab your clothes.
I swing you clear off.
I wobble from that too.
You step back; I follow half a pace.
I laugh once.
I sway my way in.
I appear here with my head tipped.
I turn a full look around.
My shadow is crooked.
I lurch to the middle.
This place smells strange.
I stop and hold still.
I work my neck once.
I heard someone here.
I want something to do.
I prop my body up slowly.
I amble your way now.
Fire catches my clothes.
I tumble down the slope.
This head of mine soaks pale.
The blast flipped me over.
Something sticks in me.
Spell light makes me jump.
Hunger softens my legs.

lines.zh: 雷一劈，我的毛全炸开了。
lines.en: The bolt hits, and every hair on me stands up.
I fall into empty space.
